result: No hidden telemetry found in reviewed source; privacy/security issues found. Not certified zero-egress.

scope.upstream_default_branch_compare: GitHub compare pinned commit...HEAD returned identical during audit
scope.upstream_reconstruction: 212 imported files still match original import hashes. Changed production source/build files retrieved at pinned commit; original selected snapshots and unchanged imports reused after SHA256 verification. Eleven modified upstream tests were not re-fetched. No missing production Swift files.

findings.status: confirmed source and existing runtime cache
findings.title: URLSession shared disk cache retains bearer credentials and cleanup request/response text
findings.observation: Read-only inspection of ~/Library/Caches/app.alfred.dictation.dev/Cache.db found archived Bearer Authorization values for ollama.com /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions. The chat request contains serialized messages with 3384 and 90 characters; the cached response contains 63 characters of message content. No token or content values were displayed or copied into this report.
findings.impact: Sensitive data exists outside Keychain and transcript-history controls. Deleting history or a Keychain entry does not remove an independent URL cache record.
findings.upstream: Same provider source and shared session defaults present in original pinned upstream.
findings.recommendation: Use a dedicated ephemeral URLSession with urlCache=nil and no persistent cookie/credential storage for sensitive providers, explicitly disable caching, and block caching in its delegate. Purge existing application URL caches when deploying the fix; consider rotating the cached credential based on exposure. Verify with fake credentials that disk cache stays empty.

findings.title: Raw and processed transcripts always persist in ordinary preferences
findings.impact: History stores last 50 entries without application-level encryption, retention expiry, or a history-disable setting. Disk encryption and filesystem access controls may still apply.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit history opt-out and age retention; use a protected dedicated store if persistence is enabled. Clear-history should also address associated caches.

findings.status: confirmed source; sensitive echoed errors conditional
findings.title: Provider-controlled error text is logged as public
findings.impact: If a server echoes transcript, prompts, or credentials in an error, it can be persisted in unredacted macOS logs. Ordinary success logs reviewed generally use counts/configuration rather than dictation contents.
findings.recommendation: Log stable provider/status/error codes, not server messages or complete localized descriptions. Keep any necessary diagnostic details private and bounded.

findings.status: confirmed dependency source; not observed leaking
findings.title: FluidAudio can send inherited Hugging Face token to configured registry or pagination host
findings.conditions: Process has HF_TOKEN/HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN/HUGGINGFACEHUB_API_TOKEN, and registry override or server-provided pagination points to an unintended host.
findings.impact: Model requests add bearer auth without binding it to a trusted origin.
findings.recommendation: Constrain registry, pagination, and redirect origins; attach a token only to its intended trusted host. Avoid inheriting unused tokens into GUI app.

findings.status: confirmed missing policy; redirect exploitation unverified
findings.title: Configurable endpoints lack app-level transport and redirect boundaries
findings.impact: Missing schemes normalize to HTTP. Context permission uses original URL locality and there is no explicit provider redirect delegate. No remote plaintext upload or redirect body/token forwarding was demonstrated.
findings.mitigation: Both built Debug/Release plists retain default ATS without exceptions; Apple documents that ATS requires HTTPS for URLSession public-host HTTP connections. Do not treat code accepting HTTP as proof of successful plaintext public-host transmission.
findings.recommendation: Validate schemes/hosts explicitly, require HTTPS beyond loopback, reject embedded credentials, and reject redirects that cross trust/locality boundaries.

findings.title: Clipboard and recovery files retain dictated material
findings.impact: Insertion uses ordinary general clipboard without transient/concealed marking, restoration, or clearing. Clipboard managers may retain it. Cancelled-session recovery defaults on and saves unencrypted audio/metadata; files are mode0600, directory0700, excluded from backups, nominal 24-hour retention pruned by running app. Files can outlive that time while app is closed.
findings.current_configuration: Cancelled-session recovery disabled in saved development-app preferences at inspection time.
findings.recommendation: Make retention choices clear; add appropriate clipboard privacy behavior and an explicit recovery opt-in.

findings.title: Most FluidAudio model revisions track mutable main branches
findings.impact: Pinned Swift package versions do not pin model bytes downloaded later. Main ASR and auxiliary CTC/tokenizer assets follow mutable upstream revisions.
findings.recommendation: Pin model revisions and expected file digests; verify all model assets before loading.

positive_controls: No analytics SDK, covert telemetry endpoint, crash-report upload, or unrelated exfiltration path found in reviewed source.

API keys normally stored in macOS Keychain; cache finding is an independent duplicate.

validation.offline_test_result: 33 tests passed, zero failures. These check storage/data helpers and are not an egress test.
validation.dependency_source_check: All three source checkout revisions match lockfile and tracked changes are clean.
validation.binary_checksum_recheck: Could not repeat archive checks: original release ZIP archives no longer present locally. Verification script reported false because archives were absent (null hashes), not because of a demonstrated differing hash. Earlier 2026-10-19 baseline recorded matching ZIP hashes; not a current attestation of extracted binaries.
validation.binary_review: Static import/dependency/strings review of llama/Nemo macOS artifacts found no obvious direct networking or telemetry symbols/endpoints; no reproducible-build proof.
validation.runtime_observation: lsof identified the running workspace development app and an open UDP443 connection to 34.36.133.15. DNS unavailable in execution sandbox; endpoint not independently attributed from that socket. An open socket does not prove active payload transfer.
validation.runtime_cache_observation: Read-only existing OS cache metadata and in-memory structural checks confirmed request credentials/message bodies and response completion persisted; no sensitive values included in output.
validation.redirect_probe: Compiled synthetic Swift URLSession probe, but localhost mock-server bind was denied by execution sandbox. No request sent; redirect forwarding remains unverified.
limitations: Static source review cannot prove absence of all runtime traffic or hidden behavior in prebuilt frameworks/OS services.
No sustained packet capture, network-denied whole-app run, or fresh real dictation/cloud upload performed.
No application source, user settings, Keychain, clipboard, history, or cache modified by audit. This report and local build/test products were written.

recommended_order: Fix sensitive HTTP caching and remediate existing cache copies.
Add an enforceable offline/no-network mode with one controlled download action and explicit cloud-provider consent.
Add history retention/opt-out, safe error logging, and clipboard/recovery privacy controls.
Constrain provider and model-registry origins; pin model assets.
Validate with fake credentials and synthetic text under monitored/blocked egress before claiming fully offline operation.
